answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Rapid Fire first at Nibbit, using the Spark bank to make it cost 0. Then I played Kaboom! at Nibbit for its printed cost of 1, and finally played Imaginary Friend for 1 energy. This deals 23 total damage, gains 5 Block, and adds the Burst-related value from Imaginary Friend while using all 2 energy.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Rapid Fire, Imaginary Friend, and Duck and Cover. That line would deal 16 damage and gain 10 Block, trading 7 damage for 5 additional Block.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up the extra 5 Block from also playing Duck and Cover. Compared with the two-block line, it has less protection against the telegraphed 12 damage, but it deals 7 more damage and still keeps the Burst-related value from Imaginary Friend.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes, in principle. A much larger attack intent could make the extra 5 Block from the two-block line more valuable, especially if it would be the difference between surviving and taking severe damage. A Defend intent or a smaller attack would not have moved me away from the higher-damage line.
